race.comment: Classy filly TRANSCEND (10) last raced when sixth in the Group 3 Adrian Knox over 2000m at Randwick in the Autumn. Two decent trials leading into this suggest she is forward enough to run a cheeky race against modest opposition. MAMUSHKA (11) was runner-up over this trip at Warwick Farm two runs ago then failed at 1400m last time. In the right race to bounce back for form. If the track conditions improve by this stage of the day her prospects are enhanced. STAGNUM (5) did little first-up at Rosehill off a 262-day break. Came from last to score impressively in a BM72 over this course and distance the run before that in October, his only appearance of that campaign. Good enough to play a key role in this company. ENGINE ROOM (3) found 1100m a bit slick first-up. Finds a more suitable race today and McDonald replacing a claiming apprentice adds a length or two. COSMEENA (7) is a good fresh performer back from a brief spell. Has won two from three at the trip so deserves consideration.
